report:
**Acceptance census #68 — bounded S04**

**Required by S04:** recover an interrupted job by reconciling process identity, candidate and recorded effects; don’t repeat an identifiable effect; block uncertain writers or unreconcilable remote outcomes; revalidate the candidate and its review before continuing. The concrete scenarios are interruption before a remote effect, interruption after PR creation but before its local response is recorded, uncertain process identity, stale review, and unreconcilable remote state ([plan-v1.md, “S04”](docs/plan-v1.md); [spec-v1.md, OPS-04–06](docs/spec-v1.md)).

**Evidence already covers a bounded supported path:** the prior coordinator-exit proof is real, but bounded to one tested coordinator child exit and fresh-reader observation—not arbitrary coordinator or main-chat restart ([`.audit/coordinator-exit-44-parent-checks.json`](.audit/coordinator-exit-44-parent-checks.json)). Committed native recovery, exact-candidate review receipt, and fake-GitHub effect journal proofs cover interrupted local work, stale-candidate blocking, and controlled before/after PR-response cases without provider prompts or real GitHub calls ([native proof](.audit/recovery-68-native-committed-proof.json); [review proof](.audit/recovery-68-review-committed-proof.json); [effects proof](.audit/recovery-68-effects-committed-proof.json)). The current successor parent replay reports PASS for one explicitly granted offline successor and its refusal/race controls ([`.audit/recovery-68-successor-parent-v3.json`](.audit/recovery-68-successor-parent-v3.json)); the frozen-snapshot standards/spec review also passes ([gate review](.audit/recovery-68-successor-gate-v1-luna.json)). But the successor change is **not integrated**, and the current review evidence is pending as you note. Don’t call #68 complete until that gate is cleared and the reviewed candidate is integrated.

**Minimal next step:** finish the successor dual gate and integrate that exact reviewed snapshot; no additional microcut is indicated by the cited evidence. No operator-only grant is needed to test or review these offline controls. A concrete operator grant **is** required to run an actual successor; a separate explicit grant is required for any real GitHub effect. Neither is authorized by this request.

**Limits / deferred:** this does not prove reboot or general environment/model-state recovery, arbitrary surviving-writer exclusion, real GitHub semantics, or whole-v1 readiness (guide and proofs: [local-worker-lifecycle.md](docs/local-worker-lifecycle.md)). #66 fallback and #67 multiwriter remain separate plan items; #70 real-GitHub H1 is not established by fake-`gh` tests. No scope expansion to every environment restart is justified by this census.
